lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno checked each mask and hat,
Where's the blessing? Is it that?
Kiki smiled, no masks, no hats,
It's good news hiding, think of that!
[chorus]
A blessing in disguise, a blessing in disguise,
Something bad turns good, surprise!
A blessing in disguise, a blessing in disguise,
Look again with brand new eyes!
[verse]
It means a thing that seems so bad
Turns out good and makes you glad,
You missed the bus, but then you found
Your best friend walking on the ground!
[chorus]
A blessing in disguise, a blessing in disguise,
Something bad turns good, surprise!
A blessing in disguise, a blessing in disguise,
Turn that frown and see the prize!
[outro]
So when bad luck comes as a surprise,
It might be a blessing in disguise!
